title: 第7章 南月集团第8章 美女总裁
lines: “南月集团？”江来手上的动作微微一顿，脑海中不自觉的浮现出那张犹如鬼斧神工般精美无暇的脸庞。
看到他陷入沉思中，秃头男还以为他害怕了，顿时松了口气，得意洋洋道：“我告诉你，我可是南月集团的经理，你要敢动我，南月集团一定不会放过你。”
“那正好。”江来点点头道：“反正我跟南月集团有私怨要解决。”
“什么？”秃头男子一惊，还未反应过来，便感觉到一阵剧痛侵袭全身，整个人直挺挺的倒了下去。
“你……你杀了他？”靠坐在墙壁旁的谭平见状，忍不住瞪大眼睛，除了害怕，更多的是恐惧。想不到眼前这青年竟然如此心狠手辣，杀人如草芥，眼都不眨一下。早知道是这种狠角色，借他十个胆也不敢得罪。
江来扫了他一眼，冷冷道：“你还留在这干什么？是不是也想跟他一样。”
听到这话，谭平顾不上身体的剧痛，手脚并用，急忙朝着外面爬去。
“记住！以后别再让我看到你，否则的话，后果自负。”
随着谭平狼狈而逃，整个敞亮的客厅中只剩下三个人。叶芙渠轻咬着薄唇，挣扎着从地上站起，慢慢挪动到江来的身边，看着倒地不起的秃头男，美眸中闪烁着复杂的情绪，痛恨，解脱，更多的是一种轻松。
“他真的死了？”
江来摇摇头道：“没有，只是晕过去了。”
叶芙渠不解道：“那你……”
“你不能只图一时痛快，如果真在这杀了他，谁来料理后事？要是在国外的话，我随时随地都能杀了他，反正有专人负责处理尸体，但这是华国，条条框框规矩太多，我现在又没帮手。另外，我还想找他打听一点事情。”
趁着秃头男还没醒来，江来坐在沙发上，叼着一根从秃头男身上搜来的雪茄，吞云吐雾，不时跟叶芙渠闲聊几句。
通过交谈，他对叶芙渠的经历总算了解了七七八八。
叶芙渠刚从影视学校毕业没几年，怀揣梦想的她四处奔波，凭借甜美的外表和傲人的身材，她的事业可谓蒸蒸日上，渐渐被公众熟知。身为一个明星，自然需要经纪人和经纪公司负责打理琐事，正是在那个时候，叶芙渠被谭平说服，加入了银盛娱乐公司。
进入公司不久，那个叫齐斌的秃头男对她非常重视，为她联系了很多知名导演，接演了不少影视剧。然而，就在她对未来满怀憧憬的时候，噩梦却突然降临。前几天，齐斌突然告诉她，让她去陪一位商业上的合作伙伴吃饭，并且要求她服从对方的一切要求。
直到那一刻她才幡然醒悟，原来齐斌一直把她当成工具在利用，之所以培养她，提高她的人气和知名度，无非是为了更好的服务客人，除了身体上，还要让客人得到精神上的满足。
她想过逃走，可是，她跟银盛娱乐签署过为期五年的合约，如果单方面解约，必须承担高额的违约金。除此之外，她家人和朋友的信息都被对方掌握，只要她敢逃，肯定会给自己的亲朋好友带来麻烦。正因为如此，心烦意乱的她才跑去酒吧买醉。
“江先生……”
“叫我江来好了，不用客套。”
叶芙渠乖巧的应了一声，问道：“你想找齐斌打听什么事情？”
“南月集团，你听说过吗？”
听到这话，叶芙渠用一种惊讶的目光看着江来，反问道：“你不知道南月集团？”
“我应该知道吗？”
“南月集团是世界五百强企业，涉及的领域非常广，总部位于QZ市，如今已有八十多年的历史。QZ市能够从以前的一线城市提升为直辖市，全是因为南月集团的功劳。据说，整个QZ市有十分之一的土地使用权都归南月集团所有。”
“我对这些不感兴趣。”江来说道：“我只想了解下南月集团的董事长。”
“你是指海流沙？”叶芙渠一怔，鄙夷的看了他一眼，撇嘴道：“我还以为你说的是真的，原来你跟别的男人没区别。”
“什么意思？”
“昨天晚上你亲口跟我说，你对漂亮女人没有好感，既然如此，那你为什么要打听海流沙的事情，难道不是因为人家长得漂亮？”说到这，叶芙渠感叹了一声，羡慕道：“都说鱼和熊掌不可兼得，但海流沙不仅家世雄厚，连长相都惊为天人。虽然我没亲眼见过，但新闻中没少播放她的照片，的确是个让所有女人都嫉妒的美女。”
江来神色淡淡道：“我知道她长得漂亮，不过，再漂亮又能怎样，终究还是要死在我的手里。”
“你说什么？”叶芙渠大吃一惊，“你……你要……”
江来点点头，很肯定的重复道：“你没听错，我要杀了她，这是我来QZ市的唯一目的。”
好一会儿，叶芙渠才从震惊中回过神来，问道：“为什么，她跟你有什么仇？”
“叶小姐，不该问的别问，做好你的分内事就行了。”说着，江来指了指冰箱，后者会意，立刻起身拿出一瓶啤酒递到他手上。
半个多小时后，昏睡中的齐斌终于江醒，他揉着胀痛的脑袋，慢慢坐了起来。
“你总算醒了。”
声音传来，齐斌抬起头，正好接触到江来那双清澈的黑眸，心头不由一颤，喃喃道：“我……我还没死？”
“别着急，当你该死的时候迟早会死，在这之前，你最好老老实实的配合我，说不定我心情好，给你一个痛快，免得让你遭受痛苦。”说完，江来拿着啤酒，在齐斌身边转了两圈，问道：“你说你是南月集团的经理，那你应该见过海流沙，对她平时的生活规律很了解。”
“你……你想干什么？”
“我要知道她平时的生活习惯和细节，比如几点上下班，途中经过的路线，车队情况，有多少随行的安保人员，什么装备配置，只要帮我把这些弄清楚，你的任务就完成了。”
听完这话，齐斌犹豫了一下，小心翼翼的说道：“其实，我……我觉得你没必要这么麻烦……”
content_en:
"Nanyue Group?" Jiang Lai's hand movements paused slightly, and the flawless face that looked like a miraculous craftsmanship appeared in his mind unconsciously.
Seeing him lost in thought, the bald man thought he was scared, so he breathed a sigh of relief and said triumphantly: "I tell you, I am the manager of Nanyue Group. If you dare to touch me, Nanyue Group will definitely not let you go."
"That's just right." Jiang Lai nodded and said, "Anyway, I have a personal grudge with Nanyue Group to resolve."
"What?" The bald man was startled. Before he could react, he felt a sharp pain attack his whole body, and he fell straight down.
"You...you killed him?" Tan Ping, who was sitting against the wall, couldn't help but widen his eyes when he saw this. In addition to fear, he was more terrified. Unexpectedly, the young man in front of me could be so cruel and ruthless, killing people without even blinking an eye. If I had known he was such a ruthless person, I wouldn't have dared to offend him even if I had ten more courages.
Jiang Lai glanced at him and said coldly: "Why are you still here? Do you want to be like him?"
Hearing this, Tan Ping ignored the severe pain in his body and hurriedly crawled outside using his hands and feet.
"Remember! Don't let me see you again, otherwise, you will be responsible for the consequences."
As Tan Ping fled in panic, only three people were left in the bright living room. Ye Fuqu bit her thin lips lightly, struggled to stand up from the ground, and slowly moved to Jiang Lai's side. Looking at the bald man who fell to the ground, her beautiful eyes flashed with complex emotions, including hatred, relief, and more of a kind of relaxation.
"Is he really dead?"
Jiang Lai shook his head and said, "No, I just fainted."
Ye Fuqu said in confusion: "Then you..."
"You can't just be happy for the moment. If you really kill him here, who will take care of the funeral? If I were abroad, I could kill him anytime and anywhere. Anyway, there is a person responsible for handling the body, but this is China, there are too many rules and regulations, and I have no help now. In addition, I also want to ask him about something."
Before the bald man woke up, Jiang Lai sat on the sofa, holding a cigar he had found from the bald man, puffing away smoke, and chatting with Ye Fuqu from time to time.
Through conversation, he finally understood something about Ye Fuqu's experience.
Ye Fuqu has just graduated from film and television school a few years ago. She is running around with dreams in mind. With her sweet appearance and proud figure, her career is booming and she is gradually becoming known to the public. As a star, it is natural to need agents and agencies to take care of trivial matters. It was at that time that Ye Fuqu was persuaded by Tan Ping to join Yinsheng Entertainment Company.
Not long after she joined the company, the bald man named Qi Bin attached great importance to her. He contacted many well-known directors for her and acted in many film and television dramas. However, just when she was looking forward to the future, the nightmare suddenly came. A few days ago, Qi Bin suddenly told her to accompany a business partner for dinner and asked her to obey all the other party's requirements.
It wasn't until that moment that she suddenly realized that Qi Bin had been using her as a tool. The reason why he trained her and increased her popularity and popularity was simply to serve the customers better, not only physically, but also to satisfy them spiritually.
She thought about running away, but she had signed a five-year contract with Yinsheng Entertainment. If she terminated the contract unilaterally, she would have to bear high liquidated damages. In addition, the other party has information about her family and friends. As long as she dares to escape, she will definitely cause trouble to her relatives and friends. Because of this, she was so upset that she went to the bar to get drunk.
"Mr. Jiang..."
"Call me Jiang Lai, no need to be polite."
Ye Fuqu responded obediently and asked, "What do you want to ask Qi Bin about?"
"Nanyue Group, have you heard of it?"
Hearing this, Ye Fuqu looked at Jiang Lai with surprise and asked, "You don't know about Nanyue Group?"
"Should I know?"
"Nanyue Group is a Fortune 500 company covering a wide range of fields. It is headquartered in QZ City and has a history of more than 80 years. QZ City was promoted from a former first-tier city to a municipality directly under the Central Government, all because of the credit of Nanyue Group. It is said that one-tenth of the land use rights in the entire QZ City is owned by Nanyue Group."
"I'm not interested in these." Jiang Lai said, "I just want to know about the chairman of Nanyue Group."
"You mean the quicksand of the sea?" Ye Fuqu was startled, looked at him with disdain, and said with a curl of his lips: "I thought what you said was true. It turns out that you are no different from other men."
"What do you mean?"
"You told me personally last night that you have no interest in beautiful women. If that's the case, then why did you ask about Hai Liusha? Isn't it because she is beautiful?" Speaking of this, Ye Fuqu sighed and said with envy: "They say you can't have your cake and eat it too, but Hai Liusha not only has a rich family background, but also has an amazing appearance. Although I haven't seen it with my own eyes, her photos are often broadcast in the news. She is indeed a beauty that makes all women jealous."
Jiang Lai said calmly: "I know she is beautiful, but no matter how beautiful she is, she will still die in my hands."
"What did you say?" Ye Fuqu was shocked, "You... you want to..."
Jiang Lai nodded and repeated firmly: "You heard me right, I want to kill her. This is the only purpose of my coming to QZ City."
After a while, Ye Fuqu recovered from the shock and asked, "Why, what grudge does she have against you?"
"Ms. Ye, don't ask what you shouldn't ask. Just do your job." After saying that, Jiang Lai pointed to the refrigerator. The latter understood and immediately stood up and took out a bottle of beer and handed it to him.
More than half an hour later, Qi Bin finally woke up from his drowsiness. He rubbed his painful head and slowly sat up.
"You finally woke up."
When the voice came, Qi Bin raised his head and came into contact with Jiang Lai's clear black eyes. His heart trembled and he murmured: "I... I'm not dead yet?"
"Don't worry, you will die sooner or later when you deserve it. Before that, you'd better cooperate with me honestly. Maybe I'm in a good mood and give you a good time to avoid you suffering." After saying that, Jiang Lai took the beer, walked around Qi Bin twice, and asked: "You said you are the manager of Nanyue Group, then you should have seen Hai Liusha and know her daily routine very well."
"You...what do you want to do?"
"I want to know her daily habits and details, such as what time she commutes to and from get off work, the routes she takes on the way, the status of her fleet, how many security personnel are accompanying her, and what equipment she has. Just help me figure this out, and your mission will be completed."
After hearing this, Qi Bin hesitated and said cautiously: "Actually, I...I don't think you need to go to such trouble..."
title_en: Chapter 7 Nanyue Group Chapter 8 Beautiful CEO
